answer: Post-Registration Random Audit Lottery. New agents enter a lagoon of pending identities and pay a fixed registration fee. After cutoff, a public verifiable-randomness beacon selects audit windows and nonces; no one can precompute them. Each chosen identity must return a unique nectar challenge response within seconds or lose the fee and be removed. The beacon also mixes a juniper salt into each challenge to prevent replay. An attacker must fund and keep every Sybil live through unpredictable audits, paying fee plus hosting and response costs per identity.
